name: @tranzfer/infra
description: Cloudflare infrastructure for Tranzfer, defined in Alchemy.

scripts.plan: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js plan --stage production
scripts.deploy: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --yes --stage production
scripts.plan:staging: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://staging.tranzfer.app node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js plan --stage staging
scripts.deploy:staging: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://staging.tranzfer.app node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --yes --stage staging
scripts.destroy: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js destroy --yes --stage production
